content.thinking: Found the color-impaired CSS overrides in themes.css and the attribute setter in ApplyTheme.tsx. Next, I'll check which components consume those variables, starting with the series index footer key and progress bars.

files.reason: Defines [data-color-impaired] overrides (line 445+) and base progress bar/status/calendar variables. Overrides are incomplete or ineffective for the status colors and bars.
Legend key at the bottom left of the series list. Its colors don't match the progress bars and may not use the color-impaired variables.
Progress bar colors and the purple fill, which is hard-coded and not overridden in color-impaired mode. The bar is also thin and low-contrast.
Thin status bars under poster cards use status/progress colors.
Overview view status colors that may not respond to color-impaired mode.
Calendar event colors: the thin color line and faint full-color backgrounds, especially in the dark theme.
Calendar legend colors that should follow the color-impaired variables.
Sets the data-color-impaired attribute on the document root, so it is the place to check that the toggle takes effect.
Settings UI containing the Enable Color-Impaired Mode checkbox.
Series index progress bar styling that affects the bar's width and contrast.
